metadata.description: Supreme Court of India has decided to hear all the petition related to the various acts of freedom of religion passed by the several state governments. The validity of these acts are challenged by some individuals as well as organisations in at least 7 states. Supreme Court of India now has asked high courts ot transfer all such cases to it.
